paragraphs: A Land Rover AJ200D engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ200D owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ200D-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover AJ200D engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ200D is Jaguar Land Rover's 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced in 2015. It's fitted across five Land Rover models.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the AJ200D?
faqLeft.a: Defender, Discovery, Discovery Sport, Range Rover Evoque and Range Rover Velar — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ200D differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, turbocharger configuration (single vs twin-turbo), and ECU calibration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ200D from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A single-turbo AJ200D from a Discovery Sport isn't a direct match for a twin-turbo AJ200D from a Defender — ancillaries, turbo setup, and ECU calibration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover AJ200D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ200D rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the common issues with the AJ200D?
faqLeft.a: Timing chain stretch and tensioner weakness, balance shaft bearing wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, plastic chain guide fragmentation, crankshaft breakage, and injector problems on higher-mileage examples.

faqRight.q: What are the symptoms of AJ200D timing chain failure?
faqRight.a: A metallic rattle on cold start is often the first clue. Other symptoms include engine hesitation or loss of power, warning lights (camshaft correlation faults, oil pressure errors), misfire codes, oil pressure drop, bearing noise, or sudden engine cut-out.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ200D from a Defender?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ200D in the Defender is one of the most common applications we see, across D150, D165, D180 and D200 variants.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ200D from a Discovery Sport?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ200D in the Discovery Sport is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover AJ200D engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ200D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ200D owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different AJ200D applications exist across the Land Rover range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
